title: Recovering a Hacked Account
paragraphs: Suatu pagi, Iman menemukan bahwa akun emailnya telah diakses orang lain semalaman, berdasarkan notifikasi login dari lokasi asing yang belum pernah ia kunjungi sebelumnya. Sedikit panik, ia segera mengganti kata sandinya dan mengaktifkan autentikasi dua faktor, fitur keamanan yang sudah lama ingin ia atur tapi terus ia tunda selama berbulan-bulan.

Selama beberapa hari berikutnya, ia dengan cermat memeriksa akun-akun yang terhubung, menemukan bahwa penyusup juga mencoba, meski gagal, mengakses aplikasi perbankannya menggunakan kata sandi yang sama yang telah bocor. Pengalaman ini mengajarkan Iman pelajaran yang kini ia bagikan kepada teman-temannya: menggunakan kata sandi yang sama di berbagai akun menciptakan satu titik kelemahan yang mudah dimanfaatkan peretas.
answerKey: One morning, Iman discovered that her email account had been accessed by someone else overnight, based on a login notification from an unfamiliar location she had never visited before. Panicking slightly, she immediately changed her password and enabled two-factor authentication, a security feature she had been meaning to set up for months but had kept postponing. Over the following days, she carefully reviewed her connected accounts, discovering that the intruder had also attempted, unsuccessfully, to access her banking app using the same compromised password. The experience taught Iman a lesson she now shares with friends: using the same password across multiple accounts creates a single point of failure that hackers can exploit easily.
